episodes.title: 'My colleague turned out to be my long lost brother' | BBC News
episodes.summary: Dave Green and Andrea Urmston met when their jobs overlapped at Manchester Airport. They became friends, but later it emerged that Dave was actually Andrea’s brother who had been adopted 40 years earlier. In this video, they tell their extraordinary story. episodes.title: Adley made a WATER SLiDE inside SPACESTATiON!! We turned work into a Birthday Waterpark with Crew!
episodes.summary: I made a iNDOOR WATERPARK!! LET'S BE FRIENDS -- https://goo.gl/a7ctjJ HEY EVERYBODY!! We snuck into the Spacestation and built a SURPRISE waterpark for Dad’s birthday the SPACESTATiON WATERPARK!! Work was CANCELLED for everyone that day and we partied ALL DAY LONG OHHH YEAHHH!! We turned the slide into a giant waterslide and everyone went down it again and again (there were some SUPER close calls haha)! We even had special guests join in, the Spacestation Gaming Astronaut and the Green Rainbow Ghost came down the slide with us!! We also had a pool filled with ORBEEZ, and stepping on those felt SO weird!! Then it was time for a HUGE pool party with an epic water fight and a full on pool noodle battle!! Once the park closed for business, we set up a nacho bar to refuel. We even got to premiere our newest family cartoon starring Mermaid Adley and the Octo-Alien!! It was such a special day, and I just know Dad had the BEST BIRTHDAY EVER!! my last video - Little Red ADLEY and a WOLF the SUMMER STORY!! made a 15 Chapter play with my daughter & our family https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P4SPHtVHQP8 my dad's last video - A for ADLEY in the BEST PARADE EVER!! episodes.title: Gen Z wants the '90s back, but it's selective nostalgia | Engagement Party
episodes.summary: The '90s are everywhere these days — clothes, music, TV — and brands are doing everything they can to capitalize on the revival. Audie and Ari explore what’s driving the modern fascination with a decade they lived through, what Gen Z's rose-colored glasses get wrong about the era, and what they wax nostalgic for (mix tapes!). Plus, comedian Rob Anderson joins Audie to discuss why nostalgia is so damn funny. Like what you heard? Sign up for our newsletter to catch up on the latest trends, obsessions and culture. Is there something in your feed you want Audie and Ari to talk about? Email us a video at engagementparty@cnn.com and we might feature you on the show. 00:00 Nostalgia for the '90s has gripped the culture. What's behind it? 0:40 Retailers are trying to cash in, and The Gap is at the top of that list 2:05 Are people nostalgic for the '90s, or are they just craving an analog life? 5:36 Even MAGA is on the '90s nostalgia train 7:02 Speaking of The Gap, they're not entirely nailing it — what's with the happy stripe mesh? 10:00 Ari does a trust fall and reveals his own '90s style 10:49 Not all the revivals are wholesome. Smoking is in again? 13:26 Audie and Ari reveal their '90s touchstones and AOL screen names 17:20 Audie interviews comedian, writer and nostalgia culture creator Rob Anderson Watch 24/7 live news with CNN Headlines: https://bit.ly/4eIvlTr #News #culture #engagementparty

episodes.title: Building at the pace of AI innovation | Grant Lee, Gamma
episodes.summary: We caught up with Grant Lee, Founder and CEO of Gamma, at RAISE Summit in Paris to discuss what it takes to build at the pace of AI innovation. As AI capabilities continue to evolve, the companies that move fastest are those that can quickly turn new breakthroughs into better products and better customer experiences. Grant shares how Gamma uses OpenAI across its platform and internal engineering workflows, why strong partnerships have been key to its growth, and why adaptability has become one of the most important advantages for businesses navigating rapid technological change.
